notes.title: The latest edition to the Japanese Rail Sim series is now on sale!
notes.notes:
[h3]The latest title in the Japanese Rail Sim series of live-action train operating games, Japanese Rail Sim: Hakone - Town of Natural Beauty and Hot Springs, is now on sale![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496205/11e5bf2efb21278ed3581124db3f80e4c2b1b0a5.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145510/EX/

[h3]This time you are heading to one of Japan's most popular tourist destinations, Hakone.
Enjoy operating a train while viewing the scenery of Hakon, filmed from the actual operator's cab![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496205/35c0b7453ffa9226f2787554f187ea16562c2422.jpg[/img]

[h3]Not only can you operate a train, but the game is also packed with tourist information, giving you a taste of what to expect when visiting Hakone! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496205/2a4d586b5387903451716445c11da565e21a3710.jpg[/img]

[h3]Supports the following languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145510/EX/

notes.title: January 23, 2023 Update
notes.notes:
Ver1.0.3

[b] It is now possible to customize keyboard settings. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496205/c85f2c05ac2f56372fed30ae0078fafff90f6c3a.png[/img]

Settings can be easily customized from the title screen or even while driving.

The default settings for keyboard operation have been partially changed.
Check the [Operation Settings (keyboard/mouse)] on the [Settings] screen,
if you intend to use this function.

[b] Portuguese (Brazil) has been added to Language in [Game Settings]. [/b]

[b] An error regarding Achievements has been resolved. [/b]

notes.title: June 29, 2022 Update
notes.notes:
Ver 1.0.2

-Fixed a deficiency in the English text on the setting screen.

notes.title: June 24, 2022 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed the problem that caused the train whistle to sound when the left stick of the controller was moved from directly above to the left.

The game now pauses when the controller is disconnected (while driving the train).
